doc: The handoff is a praxis primitive: one unit-of-work produces exactly one handoff. Praxis owns the envelope and this base schema; judgment engines register plugins that extend it (see handoff/plugins/). A handoff-generation/validation script enforces that every registered plugin's required fields come out the other side.

frontmatter.desc: the single unit of work this handoff is for -- the praxis invariant
stable id across checkpoints, replacements, resumptions
context continuity of the agent that produced it
self-reported cost (runtime gives no per-op breakdown)
worker scopes, if this unit delegated execution
interop: the root this handoff crosses to next (a root name); the delivery mechanism routes it into that root's praxis/inbox/. Present only on a cross-root (interop) handoff
interop: the root the eventual result should be addressed back to -- the reply address the receiving root reads to address its own completion handoff. Carried forward across the round-trip

sections.name: Artifact
sections.desc: the deliverable, freeform in the unit's own form

sections.name: Surfaced
sections.desc: the escape valve -- present even when empty; a missing section is a schema violation, an empty one is a statement
